Jeppesen ForeFlight is seeking a **Senior Software Engineer I** reporting to the Manager, Professional Services of Crew Implementation \& PCS in our **Bangalore** location.



As an SSE, you will work on different software solutions for commercial airlines. You will be responsible for the development of configuration layer, testing, documentation, and maintenance of crew and ops management applications to meet customer, functional, and regulatory requirements.

  



A successful candidate is passionate about solving complex real\-world problems using technology. You will work directly with clients, understanding their business and using technology to solve their problems and improve efficiency—delivering solutions that our clients truly benefit from.

  




Problem solving gets you excited, especially together with others, working tightly in a team with the client. Collaboration and communication are your strengths. You find working with people from around the world to be exciting and stimulating.

  



You enjoy working in a team and find it rewarding to work with teams in other countries. You either know about or are eager to learn about the airline industry. You see yourself contributing in workshops and communicating with different stakeholders as part of gathering requirements. You thrive in a dynamic environment and see change as something positive.

  


**Position Responsibilities****:**



As part of an agile implementation team, you will:


* Deliver client projects by configuring and customizing our world\-leading crew and ops management applications using XML, Python, and our proprietary RAVE language.
* Use a test\-driven development methodology to ensure top quality, developing automated test cases as you code.
* Work directly with clients to understand their needs and business objectives and use that information to capture requirements.
* Explain system features and customer specific configuration in a clear and confident way to clients, while managing client expectations and building long\-term client relationships.
* Travel to visit our clients on occasion.

  


**Basic Qualifications (Required Skills/Experience):**


* 7\+ years of relevant working experience
* At least 3\+ years of software development / programming / implementation experience with Python
* At least 2\+ years of working in a Linux/Unix environment
* Experience in airline operations or airline IT, ideally with crew management
* Experience with Git
* Good communication skills (both written \& verbal)

  


**Preferred Qualifications (Desired Skills/Experience)****:**


* Experience working within a Scrum team or in similar Agile project setups
* Experience with:
* Test framework like Gherkin, Behave
* Interfaces and data integration, XML, XSD
* Database configuration, big data
* Building pipelines, using tools such as GitLab, Jenkins
* Virtual machine, using tools such as Vagrant and VirtualBox

  


**Typical Education \& Experience:**


* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field

  


**About Jeppesen ForeFlight:**



Jeppesen ForeFlight is a leading provider of innovative aviation software solutions, serving the Commercial, Business, Military, and General Aviation sectors globally. Combining Jeppesen’s 90\-year legacy of accurate aeronautical data with ForeFlight’s expertise in cutting\-edge aviation technology, the company delivers an integrated suite of tools designed to enhance safety, improve operational efficiency, and sharpen decision\-making.

  


**Why You Should Join: (India)**



At Jeppesen ForeFlight, we know you want a rewarding career. To do that, you need challenging projects, a good work environment, and awesome coworkers. We believe in our employees and empower them to make a direct impact on our products and services messaging. We strive to provide employees and their loved ones with a world\-class benefits experience, focused on supporting their physical, financial, and emotional wellbeing. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. During 2019, the Company had consolidated revenues and net income of $15\.1 billion and $4\.9 billion, respectively, and a current market value of approximately $90 billion.
   

  

 Booking Holdings Bangalore is a Center of Excellence based in Bangalore, India and a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units.
   

  

 At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you make. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the food you sample. Through our products, partners and people, we can empower everyone to experience the world.

 Our FinTech Business Unit, with hubs in Amsterdam, London, Shanghai, and Bangalore, is tasked with removing financial friction from the travel process. We are building a world\-class financial infrastructure to ensure that buying and selling travel\-related products is seamless, secure, and compliant for millions of travelers and partners worldwide.
   

  

 We are currently looking for a
 **Product Manager** 
 to join our Tax track. This is a high\-impact area focused on building and maintaining tax capabilities that support the global ambitions of the business.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

 As a Product Manager in the Tax product area, you will own a defined product scope within our global tax infrastructure. You will be responsible for shaping the problem space, defining what to build, and driving delivery within your team. You will work closely with Engineering, Tax Experts, and Finance stakeholders to ensure your product area meets compliance obligations while contributing to the longer\-term platform vision.

* Roadmap Ownership: Define and maintain an 18\-month roadmap for your product area, grounded in validated customer/business insight and clear prioritization.
* Team\-Level Delivery: Own the product lifecycle within your team, from discovery and requirements through delivery, launch readiness, and operational health.
* Compliance Delivery: Ensure your product area meets regulatory and tax compliance requirements on schedule, while maintaining technical quality and reliability.
* Stakeholder Management: Act as the bridge between Engineering and non\-technical stakeholders (Finance, Accounting, Tax Experts). Translate complex technical logic into business context for your stakeholder group.
* Cross\-Team Alignment: Coordinate across dependencies with other teams in the Tax track and broader FinTech org, identifying and mitigating risks early.
* Operational Excellence: Own team\-level success metrics, including platform health, data integrity, and delivery velocity. Ensure operational readiness (monitoring, alerting, rollback plans) for every release.


 What You'll Bring
   

  

* 4\-6 years of Product Management experience. Experience working on Platform, Infrastructure, or Regulatory compliance products is a plus.
* Technical Comfort: You can discuss API contracts, data schemas, and system dependencies with Engineers, and translate those into product decisions.
* Delivery Track Record: Experience operating in complex, legacy environments. You can manage delivery while navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities.
* Stakeholder Communication: Strong communication skills with the ability to align a stable set of stakeholders across disciplines and manage expectations clearly.
* Domain Interest: Prior exposure to FinTech, Payments, or Tax Technology is a good to have, not a requirement.
* Agency: You are hands\-on and detail\-oriented. You don't just identify problems; you drive them to resolution within your team.
